entry.title: Something you enjoy beyond parenting
entry.summary: Leave a little room for something you enjoy: a book unrelated to parenting, some music, or a conversation with a friend. The books offer personal possibilities to choose from.
entry.cue: When most of your reading, conversations, and time have become about parenting.
detail: Both books make room for the adult’s own interests and learning. You can choose something you already enjoy, or something you would like to return to.
Their morning and evening practices are personal examples. Davies explicitly offers a routine with the children when time alone before everyone wakes is not possible.
The Baby authors introduce their calm ideas as things that helped them; Davies says her practices may not fit every family. There is room to choose what suits your life.

principle.text: An adult’s own interests and enjoyment deserve space in family life.
